response_text: Co-operative multitasking is where the thread yields control voluntary as specified by the user and the OS preforms a switch when the yield function is called. In the case of pre-emptive this is where the thread is forced to switch after a certain time has passed, this requires that the os maintains a count of the length of how long the thread has been running before it makes a switch to another thread.\n
